I meditate on righteousness to ascribe righteousness to my Creator; I ask for judgments of righteousness and raise my voice like a Shofar. When none proclaims in righteousness and none pursues righteousness, I call out for a hearing in righteousness in a voice mingled with the Shofar. I understood through my knowledge when I raised my mind far distant and know that the utterance of Teruah sounded at the Revelation through the Shofar. By blowing Teruah I appease my shepherd, who strengthens my arm through the powerful sound of the Shofar. I approached on the day of justice to plead for myself with justice; He reveals the depths of justice through the curdling sound of the Shofar. If I am guilty in justice according to the decree of law and justice, may my throat restrain the severity of justice through my voice together with the Shofar. blocks.text: I hasten for aid and find God near me at the time when I call with my voice. In the congregation of God, He stands in my midst and here in this miniature sanctuary I mutter to Him with my voice. Test me, examine me, a stray sheep am I, I have been cast off and silenced so that I cannot raise my voice. When my shearers say ‘she is rejected’, her guardian and protector does not roar with His voice. When I conversed of His statutes and my sound was pleasing, He inclined His ear and spoke; ‘Let me hear the sound of your voice’. Swiftly He fled from me like the deer on the rocky mountains, when He desired law and a sign from me and in my dwellings there was no voice. He who leapt from fragment to fragment (Abraham), let him restore Him to me, perhaps He will raise your face because you heard His voice. blocks.text: וְנִלְוָה לִי בַּשְּׁבִי. עִמּוֹ אָנֹכִי. אָז הִבְטִיחַנִי בְּקוֹל: יָרַד לְשִׁנְעָר. וְשָׂם כֵּס בְּעֵילָם. הִשְׁמִיעַ כַּאֲרִי. וּכְנָחָשׁ קוֹל: כִּלָּה מֶנִּי דּוֹב. כְּהִתְרַפָּה מִמְּלֶאכֶת. חַק בַּמִּכְתָּב. וַיַּעֲבֶר קֹל: כָּבַשׁ לִי. אַרְבָּעָה רָאשֵׁי נָמֵר. וְגַם אֲנִי בְּהוֹדָיוֹת סֶלָה. אַשְׁמִיעַ לוֹ קוֹל: לְחַיַּת קָנֶה. אָז מָכַר אֶרֶץ. מִי לִי בַשָּׁמַיִם. אָז הֵרִימָה קוֹל: לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי. מִשִּׁנֵּי בַרְזֶל שִׁוַּעְתִּי. וּמֵרֶגֶל עַבְטִיט. הִצְרַחְתִּי בְּקוֹל: מִדַּת קִצִּי. לֹא הוֹדִיעַנִי. מָתַי בְּאַרְצִי. תּוֹר יַשְׁמִיעַ קוֹל: מִיּוֹדְעֵי סֵפֶר. חָתַם קִצִּי. לְבַל דַּעַת צוֹפַי. עֵת יִשְׂאוּ קוֹל: נָא הַבֵּט וּרְאֵה. עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי. אֵין לִי מַכִּיר. לְמִי אֶשָּׂא קוֹל: נֶצַח אֲקַוֶּה. כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל דָּבָר. מִמַּקְשִׁיבֵי. דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל: שׂוֹשׂ יָשִׂישׂ. לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי. בְּשָׁמְעִי דּוֹדִי דּוֹפֵק. עַל פְּתָחַי קוֹל:

blocks.text: 139 Musaph for the New Year 139

the whole year is banished by the sound of the Shofar. The form of the nine benedictions corresponds to the nine Shofar blasts; in His purity He allows them to entreat through the prescribed sound of the Shofar. Even those stained with evil, when they repent of transgression, Thou dost soothe their wound at the sound of the cry of the Shofar. Better than the sacrificial bullock and the splendid ram is the day appointed for the sound of renewal of the Shofar. The evil impulse is broken and the accuser disgraced and the upright heart refreshed at the sound of beauty of the Shofar. When once they blew the Shofar (before Jericho), they cleaved asunder the valley; they caused cities to sink through the tumult of the sound of the Shofar. All the multitude of the wicked will shake with trembling when they cry out aloud with a sound as piercing as the Shofar. When His voice is heard, every settlement is terrified, He blows away peoples in a hurricane
On Sabbath.
uncertainties: Printed in italics

blocks.text: in captivity, ‘I am with him’ He assured me then with His voice. He went down to Shinear and set up His throne in Elam, where He made heard like a lion and like a serpent a voice. He saved me from the bear — when the work from the Sanctuary was disturbed — which had been inscribed in writing and proclaimed by a voice. He subdued for me the four heads of the leopard and in my gratitude I make heard to Him my voice. He then sold the land to the wild beast of the reeds, ‘who is above me in heaven?’ it boasted aloud with its voice. To the God of my salvation from the teeth of iron I cried and from before the trampling foot I shrieked with my voice. He has not made known to me the measure of my end, when in my land the turtle dove will make heard its voice. Even from scholars has He concealed my end, that my seers may not know the time when they will lift up their voice. Pray look and see my woe and my pain, there is no friend to me to whom I can raise my voice. For ever shall I hope that no word shall be omitted from those who listen for a still small voice. In my midst my heart rejoices when I hear my Beloved sounding on my doors with His voice.
uncertainties: 'Shinear' is the printed spelling and is preserved.

verdict: The primary Hebrew for s294, s296 and s298 is NOT acceptable as frozen; it needs the corrections listed, so this range is not ready for acceptance. Its main errors: it printed קוֹלִי for every Shabbat refrain, which the image prints as קוֹל or בְּקוֹל. It dropped הוֹשַׁע on s296. It got many consonants wrong, especially at acrostic openings (גַּשְׁתִּי, זִקֵּק, טֶבַע, טָהוֹר, טֶנֶף, כָּבַשׁ), in the ־פוּף and ־זוֹ rhymes on s296, and in whole phrases on s298. It also misread the Shabbat Rashi attribution. The blind reading is much closer to the image and was mostly confirmed. Its rubric reading חַזָּן was rejected in favour of אַם. The English pages need only three punctuation fixes (s295 'spoke;', s297 'seek Him, He', s299 'Pray look'). The two ק׳ role labels are recorded separately and kept out of the prayer text. Running headers are recorded separately and are not body text. No missing quotation marks or other definite source misprints were found. The only proposal is וְסוֹטֵן, and it is not overwritten. Vowel-level pointing is limited by the image resolution; the remaining doubtful words are listed for human checking. Boxes are approximate original-JPG pixels (1368×2264) and are padded to include vowels above and below the line. No files were edited.
